name: inputs/segmented-control
title: Segmented control
description: A small set of exclusive options with a sliding marker.

files.content:
export { SegmentedControl } from './SegmentedControl';
export type { SegmentedControlProps, SegmentOption } from './SegmentedControl';

keyboard.action: Move into the group (onto the selected option) and out again.

notes: A `radiogroup` named by its label, containing native `<input type="radio">` elements, so the selected state and position (“2 of 3”) are announced by the browser.
Arrow keys move and select, as they do for any radio group; only the selected option is in the Tab order.
The selected option is marked by a raised marker with a magenta rule as well as text colour.
Each option is at least 38 px tall (32 px in the small size).
accessibility.reducedMotion: The marker jumps to the selection instead of sliding.
